tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Screen background behind everything.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces on bg: lead story card, favourite cards, sheets, drawer.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Input fields and keypad keys (Siirry sivulle…).

tokens.name: skeleton
tokens.usage: Loading placeholder bars only.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface and field: headlines, body.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: page numbers, timestamps, inactive tabs, neutral section labels. 4.5:1 on bg and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines between list rows and above the tab bar. Decorative, never the only separator of meaning.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Tappable page links in article text (underlined) and in the Aiheesta list (number + ›).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring around the focused control.

tokens.name: section-news
tokens.usage: Kotimaa / Uutiset: section label, dot, active tab. Never for body text.

tokens.name: section-world
tokens.usage: Ulkomaat: section label and dot.

tokens.name: section-business
tokens.usage: Talous: section label and dot.

tokens.name: section-sport
tokens.usage: Urheilu: section label, dot, active Urheilu tab.

tokens.name: section-weather
tokens.usage: Sää: section label, dot, active Sää tab.

tokens.name: section-other
tokens.usage: Sections without their own colour: Alueet, In English, Svenska, Ohjelmat.

tokens.name: price-up
tokens.usage: Rising price changes (+0,52) in the stock and fund tables, Yle's yellow. Text only, the sign stays. 4.5:1 on bg and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: price-down
tokens.usage: Falling price changes (-5,89) in the stock and fund tables, Yle's blue. Text only, the sign stays. 4.5:1 on bg and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error state icon and title only (page not found, no connection).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the screen behind the drawer and the Siirry sheet.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Lead story on the front page.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles: app name, Suosikit, Siirry.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Tuki maksettaisiin talven aikana kahdessa erässä.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Lead ingress, list rows in drawer and Aiheesta, field text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels, always uppercase, in the section colour.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Page numbers and times; use tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in tabs.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between section dot and label; small stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside cards; header stack.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between paragraphs.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter on list screens.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter on article screens (narrower measure).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between front-page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small chips and keypad keys.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Fields, jump tiles, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards: lead story, favourites; top corners of sheets.

tokens.name: touch
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable.

tokens.name: dot
tokens.usage: Section colour dot.
